explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/914: 'Equivalently, every graph with rm vertices and maximum degree at most m−1 has a proper vertex colouring with m colours in which every colour class has exactly r vertices (an equitable colouring).' The Lean variant states exactly this for r ≥ 2, m ≥ 1: a finite G on rm vertices with maxDegree ≤ m − 1 has a proper colouring C : G.Coloring (Fin m) with every colour class of size r. This is the Hajnal–Szemerédi theorem (equivalent to the main statement by taking complements). Faithful.
